experiment: direct full-byte 12A phase signatures in executed controller-fed PROM streams

fixture.sample_site: every 375th 12A Y; early raw-PROM gate/Y ordering
fixture.filtered_phase: Q=0.5 candidate bandpass and fixed +6-sample alignment
fixture.input: actual 8031-derived zero-run line bytes in 32-symbol preamble and 32-symbol data window

limitations: The Y-to-74LS273 data path, divided latch clock, DAC08 bus, analog output and line filter remain assumed.
A digital DAC-code phasor is not a measurement of Nokia analog current or an identified line-output sample stream.
The controller D127 pulse and sample alignment are declared fixture hypotheses.
